variable_semantics.QObs(mm/d): Observed streamflow normalized by catchment area as runoff depth in mm/day; observed hydrological response in the reduced Caravan hydrology benchmark input.
variable_semantics.p_mean: Long-term mean daily precipitation over the catchment, used as a static climate descriptor of water input.
variable_semantics.pet_mean: Long-term mean daily potential evapotranspiration over the catchment, representing atmospheric evaporative demand.
variable_semantics.p_seasonality: Precipitation seasonality and timing index; positive values indicate summer-peaking precipitation, negative values indicate winter-peaking precipitation, and values near zero indicate more uniform precipitation through the year.
variable_semantics.frac_snow: Fraction of precipitation falling as snow, typically estimated from precipitation on days with air temperature below 0 C.
variable_semantics.aridity: Aridity index: ratio of mean potential evapotranspiration to mean precipitation; larger values indicate a drier, more water-limited catchment climate.
variable_semantics.high_prec_freq: Frequency of high-precipitation days, conventionally days with precipitation at least five times the catchment mean daily precipitation.
variable_semantics.high_prec_dur: Average duration of high-precipitation events, counted as consecutive days meeting the high-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.high_prec_timing: Season during which most high-precipitation days occur, e.g. winter, spring, summer, or autumn.
variable_semantics.low_prec_freq: Frequency of dry days, conventionally days with precipitation below 1 mm/day.
variable_semantics.low_prec_dur: Average duration of dry periods, counted as consecutive dry days below the low-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.low_prec_timing: Season during which most dry days occur.
variable_semantics.gauge_lat: Latitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.gauge_lon: Longitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.area_gages2: Catchment drainage area from gauge metadata.

shape.timePoints: County cases from 2020-03-01 to 2022-12-31; 3,142 FIPS rows and 1,036 daily date columns in Cases.csv.
shape.variables: Cases; static county age-group shares; population; vaccination; calendar features; weekly national cases by age group for sensitivity validation.
shape.dimensions: Panel of 3,142 county FIPS series with one case-count response variable and multiple static/dynamic covariates.

variable_semantics.Cases: Daily cumulative reported COVID-19 case count for a U.S. county FIPS panel.
variable_semantics.Vaccination: County-level COVID-19 vaccination time series from the public experiment file.
variable_semantics.UNDER5: Static share of county population under age 5.
variable_semantics.AGE517: Static share of county population ages 5-17.
variable_semantics.AGE1829: Static share of county population ages 18-29.
variable_semantics.AGE3039: Static share of county population ages 30-39.
variable_semantics.AGE4049: Static share of county population ages 40-49.
variable_semantics.AGE5064: Static share of county population ages 50-64.
variable_semantics.AGE6574: Static share of county population ages 65-74.
variable_semantics.AGE75PLUS: Static share of county population age 75 and older.
variable_semantics.Population: County population attribute used to contextualize county-level COVID-19 rates and features.
variable_semantics.Day: Calendar day feature derived from the timestamp.
variable_semantics.Month: Calendar month feature derived from the timestamp.
variable_semantics.Weekday: Calendar day-of-week feature derived from the timestamp.

instance_semantics.FIPS: U.S. county Federal Information Processing Standards code.

shape.timePoints: Raw cases cover 2020-01-22 to 2022-05-17; benchmark configuration uses 2020-02-29 to 2022-05-17.
shape.variables: Static: age distribution and health disparities. Dynamic: disease spread, transmissible cases, vaccination, social distancing. Known future: SinWeekly and CosWeekly. Dynamic variable: Cases.
shape.dimensions: Panel of 3,142 county FIPS series with one case-count response variable and multiple static/dynamic covariate groups.

variable_semantics.Cases: Daily cumulative reported COVID-19 case count for a U.S. county FIPS panel; forecasting.
variable_semantics.HealthDisp: Static county health-disparity and social-vulnerability covariate group.
variable_semantics.DiseaseSpread: Dynamic county-level disease-spread covariate group used by the GPCE COVID benchmark.
variable_semantics.Transmission: Dynamic transmissible-case covariate group used to represent infectious pressure from recent cases.
variable_semantics.SinWeekly: Known future sine transform of weekly calendar seasonality.
variable_semantics.CosWeekly: Known future cosine transform of weekly calendar seasonality.

instance_semantics.FIPS: U.S. county Federal Information Processing Standards code.
